scope: Frozen raw-output expectations (PR5 Gate A and the expectations that reuse them) that LOSAT is known not to match. A listed case passes only when its output equals allowed_actual_sha256; any other output fails. A listed case that matches its frozen hash again, or that a full run does not execute, fails so that the entry is removed. The frozen hashes themselves are never rewritten.

entries.reason: The frozen PR5 Gate A bytes (3f27c1f1...) are the output of the v0.1.0 LOSAT, which differed from NCBI: 5 of 6482 outfmt 7 lines had the same coordinates, e-value and bit score but a different equal-score greedy traceback (gap openings, length, mismatches, identity). Current LOSAT outputs ac8177764f..., byte-identical to NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 for the same command and to the registered Linux NCBI fingerprint (ncbi_platform_variance_v010.json). PR5 Gate A steps 11/52/53 stay a historical HARD_FAIL; the new expectation ac8177764f... is the separately approved authority version (2026-09-28).
